name: Miriam
title: Prophetess and Praise Singer
summary: Miriam was the older sister of Moses and Aaron. As a child, she watched over Moses in the basket of reeds on the Nile. She was a prophetess who led the women of Israel in praise after crossing the Red Sea. Her criticism of Moses led to leprosy, but she was healed after Moses interceded for her.

keyEvents.title: By the Nile
keyEvents.description: The young Miriam watched over Moses in the basket of reeds and suggested to Pharaoh's daughter that they hire a Hebrew nurse—their own mother.

keyEvents.title: Song of Victory by the Sea
keyEvents.description: After crossing the Red Sea, Miriam took up a tambourine and led the women in song and dance to honor God.

keyEvents.title: Criticism of Moses
keyEvents.description: Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses for his Cushite wife and challenged his unique role as God's spokesperson.

keyEvents.title: Leprosy and Healing
keyEvents.description: God struck Miriam with leprosy, but Moses prayed for her and she was healed after seven days of isolation.

keyEvents.title: Death at Kadesh
keyEvents.description: Miriam died in Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and was buried there, near the end of the wilderness journey.
